kernel.governing_law: The source asserts that local, small-scale hustles — scrounging, scamming, consuming, performing — are registrations of a single distributed process: the circulation of scarcity through a community, where every petty transaction is the whole economy arriving at the scale of a body.
kernel.mutated_relation: Each bounded hustle becomes the distributed process itself — scarcity-as-circulation made primary, so that every unit speaks not as a local act but as the systemic current those acts locally registered.
